column4: Communicates the dual value proposition: discover investable founders and practice a pitch with AI. Give marketplace and simulator equal prominence.
Entry point for creating or accessing an account.
Lets a person enter as a Founder or Investor, routing them into substantially different experiences.
Home base: profile status, Pitch-Readiness Score, simulator CTA, messages, and upgrade status.
The most substantial form in the product. It needs draft/publish states, progressive sections, inline examples, and jargon tooltips.
Shows the LLM profile-review result: category scores, flags, total score, and whether the profile is publishable. A low score must feel like “improve draft,” not rejection.
Lets the founder see what investors will see, including score badge, published details, and selected audio pitch.
A deliberately short, low-friction profile form that captures sector, stage, geography, and cheque-size range. 03-founder-profile.md
Core marketplace browsing surface: keyword search, filter controls, search results, locked-Pro affordances, and a mocked saved-search interaction. 04-investor-profile.md
Full investment view: problem, solution, market, traction, team, business model, funding ask, score/badges, and audio pitch. Contact information must never be exposed directly. 04-investor-profile.md
The post-intro interaction surface. Investors request intros; founders can always read and reply for free. 04-investor-profile.md
Sets context before practice: the founder’s startup, session type, free-vs-Pro notice, microphone readiness, and generated investor panel.
The simulator’s centerpiece: live microphone capture, timer/progress, transcript feedback, the three AI investor personas, and clear recording state. 05-search-discovery.md
Transition from pitch to investor questioning, with persona speaker state, voiced question, and the founder’s recorded response. 05-search-discovery.md
Core learning outcome: score breakdown, words-per-minute, filler count, transcript, and substantive feedback from each persona. 05-search-discovery.md
Explains the specific unlocks: unlimited scored simulations, score contribution, ability to earn verification, analytics, and boosted placement. 06-ai-simulator.md
Success/cancel destination after Bachs hosted checkout; confirms subscription status and directs the user to the next valuable action. 06-ai-simulator.md
